notes: v581 — WHY ‘0 PROMISING’ CAN BE HONEST. The evidence strip counted every graded line — including sequences (which can never appear on a buy list), warning-direction lines, and lines proven real but too small to trade — while the radar can only badge shares from lines that clear all of those bars. So the strip could say ‘8 building lines’ while zero of them could actually badge a share, and a 0 PROMISING tile looked broken when it was forced. The strip now counts only badge-capable lines and, when others were set aside, says how many and exactly why — so the screen answers the question itself. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
